clips.title: Dual panes and tabs
clips.summary: Two independent panes, each with its own tabs, breadcrumbs and view mode.
clips.alt: A new tab opens in the left pane and drills into 02 Product and Renders, switches to a thumbnail tiles view, steps back with the breadcrumb, returns to the first tab, then focus moves to the right pane.

clips.title: A terminal in every tab
clips.summary: Each tab's PowerShell follows the folder you open in the pane.
clips.alt: Ctrl+` opens a PowerShell drawer under the Project files pane. Opening the 04 Launch folder sends a Set-Location to the prompt, and Get-ChildItem | Select -First 5 lists the folder's files.

clips.title: Disk Map
clips.summary: A nested treemap of exact disk allocation, with the largest files beside it.
clips.alt: Disk Map scans C:\Demo\Project files and draws a nested treemap coloured by file type. Hovering names each block, focusing 02 Product zooms the map into that folder, and the Top Files table lists the biggest files.

clips.title: Transfer preview and undo
clips.summary: See every copy, rename, overwrite and skip before a byte moves, then undo the whole batch.
clips.alt: 360 photos are copied to the other pane with F5. The transfer preview lists each destination with three conflicts set to rename, overwrite and skip. Apply starts a journaled copy with live progress in Operations, and Undo restores all 360 items.

clips.title: 100,000 files, no waiting
clips.summary: A folder with 100,000 entries opens instantly and scrolls without stutter.
clips.alt: Opening Sensor logs, a folder of 100,000 CSV files, shows rows immediately while the full list loads; the pane scrolls smoothly through the listing and End jumps to reading-100000.csv.

clips.title: Filtered search
clips.summary: Combine name, size, date and type filters, and get the results in the pane.
clips.alt: The Search dialog is set to files larger than 5 MB modified in the last 7 days under C:\Demo\Project files. Six matches appear with their sizes and dates, and closing the dialog leaves them listed in the left pane.

clips.title: Compare and sync
clips.summary: Compare two folders and preview the sync plan before anything changes.
clips.alt: Compare runs on the Website folders in both panes and marks files only on the left, only on the right and newer on the left. Plan L->R then previews a sync that copies two files and replaces one; nothing is applied.

clips.title: Previews, including 3D
clips.summary: Text, images, PDFs and STEP or STL models preview in the side panel.
clips.alt: Selecting files in the left pane updates the preview panel: a README as text, a landscape PNG, a one-page PDF brief, then a STEP bracket assembly rendered in 3D and orbited by dragging.

clips.title: Command palette
clips.summary: Ctrl+P finds any of 100+ commands by fuzzy search.
clips.alt: Ctrl+P opens the Command Center; typing split horizontal filters the command list, and Enter stacks the panes top and bottom. A second search, split vertical, puts them back side by side.

clips.title: Safe rename
clips.summary: Rename refuses to overwrite an existing file, and every rename can be undone.
clips.alt: F2 on launch-plan.md and typing README.md is refused with the message that an item named README.md already exists. Renaming to launch-plan-final.md succeeds, and Undo in Operations restores launch-plan.md.

clips.title: Keyboard-first
clips.summary: Arrow keys, Shift+F10 menus and every dialog work without a mouse, with visible focus.
clips.alt: Arrow keys move a visible focus ring down the file list to budget-2026.xlsx; Shift+F10 opens its context menu, arrows walk the menu to Create Checksums, Enter opens the checksum dialog, and Esc closes it.

clips.title: Live AI context over MCP
clips.summary: An AI client sees your active pane and can reveal files in it, through a local read-only MCP profile.
clips.alt: A real Codex CLI run through Explore Better's local MCP server with a read-only profile: get_context reads the active pane, search_files finds release-checklist.md, and show_in_explore_better opens 04 Launch in the left pane with the file selected. Model thinking time is trimmed and labelled.

clips.title: Scoped AI access
clips.summary: Each AI client gets a profile: its folders, its tools, and an audit log of every call.
clips.alt: In Preferences, the AI Bridge profile Project files - read only is authorized for C:\Demo\Project files only, its tool permissions show read tools enabled and write tools off, and the audit history lists the get_context, search_files and show_in_explore_better calls.
